verdict.line: You lose if you let him poke you to half HP before level 6; you win any all-in once E (Apprehend) lands inside his Disdain cooldown.

brief.thesis: This is an even matchup by the numbers (46.1% Darius win rate over 1632 games) because Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) and auto-attacks out-trade you at range, but Darius has the higher solo-kill ceiling once he closes the gap. The entire lane is a question of whether you can force fights on your terms with E (Apprehend) before Urgot's kit resets, since outside of that pull Darius has no way to close distance on a ranged champion.

theirWindow.what: Urgot can charge through minions to shield himself and throw you out of position if you walk up carelessly. OP.GG flags this directly: be wary of E while closing in to fight him from level 3 onward.

yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Walk him down, land E (Apprehend) to pull him in, then chain Q (Decimate) and W (Crippling Strike) to stack Hemorrhage before he can reposition.

start.why: the higher-winrate start (45.5% over 1212 games) gives the sustain and AD to trade autos back into his poke rather than just absorbing it

boots.why: by far the dominant pick (83.9% over 1631 games) — the flat damage reduction blunts his auto-attack and Corrosive Charge chip damage every single trade

core.why: the active haste closes the gap on a kiting ranged opponent and is the first item in the highest-winrate path (53.4% over 178 games)
builds speed while walking him down, converting into armor and a slowing auto once you're finally on top of him
the damage reduction and bleed-out heal let you survive his poke phase long enough to reach your all-in levels

situational.when: he is building toward burst or you need to survive his Fear Beyond Death execute threshold
his team adds heavy magic damage on top of his physical poke
you want an earlier gap-close option before Youmuu's active is online

runes.keystoneWhy: the stacking adaptive force and healing reward you for staying in extended trades against his poke, which is exactly what this lane demands (44.1% win rate, 21.1% pick on this page)

summoners.why: Ignite is the second most-run combo here (43.5% win rate, 19.9% pick) and secures kills through his sustain once E (Apprehend) locks him down, since Ghost doesn't help you catch a champion with a dash

playing.title: Hold E for his Disdain window
playing.detail: Don't throw Apprehend into range just to poke — save it to initiate the instant Disdain goes on cooldown (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) so he has no escape from the all-in.

playing.title: Track his passive before level 3
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read holds: avoid eating his passive proc at level 1, since early trades you lose here snowball into a lane you can't close distance in.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown windows, not HP bars
playing.detail: His kit resets fast — fight when Disdain and Purge are down, not just when he looks low, or he'll shield and throw you away mid-combo.

playing.title: Threaten R at level 6 immediately
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with Hemorrhage stacks and ignores his armor stacking — this is your first real kill threat and it arrives before his Fear Beyond Death at 11.

playing.title: Respect Fear Beyond Death past level 11
playing.detail: Once he hits his ultimate, low-HP all-ins become a liability — his execute threshold punishes exactly the trades that worked for you levels 6-10.

playing.title: Use minions to close the gap
playing.detail: Walk up behind minion waves so his Corrosive Charge and autos have to pass through bodies first, cutting down the number of free pokes he gets before you're in range.

playing.title: Finish stacks with W before R
playing.detail: Crippling Strike's slow keeps him from kiting out of Guillotine range — land it before you commit your ultimate, not after.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown timers, ability behavior, and tactical reasoning are drawn from the live game files and my own judgment.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s passive ability while on level 1. After reaching level 3, be wary of his (E) while closing in on him to fight and kill him.
